guide_claims.context_text: Native expanded range is not Keen. Bow of Sinew’s item page specifically explains its printed 19-20 range as a base 5% plus a bonus 5%, with Improved Critical applying only to the base and yielding 18-20. Do not extrapolate that item-specific explanation to every printed 19-20 bow. Sapphire Sting’s item page lists 19-20/x3; Keen is not listed; its post-Improved-Critical interaction is not verified here.

guide_claims.name: Keen explanation
required: Keen is not listed among Sapphire Sting’s enchantments.
guide_claims.context_text: Keen does not stack. Keen “does not stack with Improved Critical feat” (Keen page). Once the matching Improved Critical feat is active, Keen supplies no additional threat-range increase; the bow’s other properties can still matter. Keen is not listed among Sapphire Sting’s enchantments.
